raw_segments.text: Clytemnestra. Here then the sanction of the oath I swear, by the great vengeance for my
murdered child, by eight, by the fury unto whom this man lies sacrificed by hand of mine.
I do not look to tread the Hall of Fear, while in this hearth and home of mine there burns
the light of love—a jisthus, as of old loyal, a stalwart shield of confidence, as true to
me as this slain man was false, wronging his wife with paramours at Troy, fresh from the
abyss of each crises there. Behold him dead. Behold his captive prize,
Cirrus and Harlot—comfort of his bed, true prophetess, true paramour. I want the sea
bench was not closer to the flesh, full oft, of every rower than was she. See, ill they
did, and ill requites them now. His death he know. She has a dying swan saying her last
dirge, and lies, as erst she lay, close to his side, and to my couch has left a sweet
new taste of joys that know no fear.
